title: The 4 Best Countertop Ice Makers Under $200
h1: The 4 Best Countertop Ice Makers Under $200
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for countertop ice makers under $200, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at countertop ice makers under $200 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Euhomy Nugget Ice Maker Countertop
products.blurb: Key specs: Up to 34 lbs of nugget ice per day, First batch ready in about 6 minutes, Self-cleaning cycle.
strengths: Genuine nugget ice texture at roughly a third of the GE Opal's typical price
34 lbs a day and a 6-minute batch cycle both beat most bullet-ice machines at this budget
Self-cleaning cycle and carry handle add real convenience
limitations: No app, scheduling, or WiFi features
Smaller reservoir than premium nugget ice machines, more frequent refills
Larger footprint than a basic bullet-ice machine
features: Up to 34 lbs of nugget ice per day
First batch ready in about 6 minutes

products.name: Igloo Automatic Self-Cleaning Ice Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 26 lbs of ice per 24 hours, 9 cubes ready in about 7 minutes, Automatic 5-cycle self-cleaning function.
strengths: Comfortably priced within this budget with room to spare
Self-cleaning cycle and cube size selector cover most household needs
Smaller, easier-to-place footprint than the Euhomy
limitations: 26 lbs a day is lower output than the Euhomy's 34 lbs
Bullet-style ice melts faster than nugget ice
features: Large or small cube size selector

products.name: Silonn Countertop Nugget Ice Maker, 44 lb/Day
strengths: Chewable nugget ice at a lower price than premium brands
Timer for ice ready when you need it
limitations: Ice basket is not refrigerated, so ice slowly melts
Daily output depends on room and water temperature
Needs regular descaling with hard water

products.name: EUHOMY Countertop Bullet Ice Maker, 26 lb/Day
strengths: Carry handle for RVs and parties
limitations: Ice melts in the unrefrigerated basket

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
